interface.signature: logistic_map(width: int, height: int, x_coords: List[int], y_coords: List[int]) -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.description: The width of the map must be greater than 0.
The height of the map must be greater than 0.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < width for x in x_coords)
preconditions.description: All x coordinates must be within the bounds of the map width.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= y < height for y in y_coords)
preconditions.description: All y coordinates must be within the bounds of the map height.

postconditions.description: The result must have the same number of rows as the map height.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == width for row in result)
postconditions.description: Each row in the result must have the same number of columns as the map width.

postconditions.expression: result == [[None]*width for _ in range(height)] if not x_coords and not y_coords else [[min(abs(x-i) + abs(y-j) for x, y in zip(x_coords, y_coords)) for i in range(width)] for j in range(height)]
postconditions.description: If there are no supply points, return a map filled with None. Otherwise, return a map with the Manhattan distance to the nearest supply point for each cell.
